Clothes with strong contrast: a faded khaki auto driver uniform shirt worn OPEN over a dark charcoal vest, sleeves rolled above the elbows, the shirt hanging loose and untucked; a bright red and white checked cotton gamchha tied loosely around his neck with the ends hanging down the front, his signature item; dark navy cotton trousers with a worn brown belt, worn brown leather sandals; an old plain steel wristwatch on his left wrist and a thin black thread on the right wrist. He should be recognisable from across a street by his silhouette: the open khaki shirt over the dark vest and the red gamchha.
